test_max_iter_with_warm_start_validation: test that HistGradientBoosting raises ValueError when max_iter is smaller than n_iter_ with warm_start enabled
test_warm_start_yields_identical_results: test that fitting with warm_start in two steps yields identical results as fitting in one step
test_warm_start_max_depth: test that HistGradientBoosting fits trees of different max_depth values across multiple warm_start calls
test_warm_start_early_stopping: test that early stopping occurs after a small number of iterations when refitting with warm_start
test_warm_start_random_seeds: test that random seeds are correctly set and preserved in warm_start context for various random_state types
